verses.en: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.sm: Atua e o lé taui ma sui, ia e faaali mai lou pupula. Ta e tulai mai, o oe le faamasino o le lalolagi;

verses.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.sm: ia e tuu atu le taui i e ua faasausili. Le ALII e, e mitamita seia afea o e amio leaga;

verses.en: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.sm: e mitamita o e amio leaga seia afea? Ua latou soona tautala i upu faamaualuga,

verses.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.sm: ua mitamita vale o i latou uma o e fai amio leaga. Le ALI e, ua latou tu‘imomomoina lou nuu,

verses.en: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.sm: ua latou faatigaina foi lou tofi. O le fafine ua oti lana tane atoa ma le tagata ese,

verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.sm: ua latou fasiotia, ua larou fasiotia foi ma e matuaoti;

verses.en: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.sm: ma ua faapea a latou, E le silasila mai e le ALII, e le manatua foi e le Atua o Iakopo.

verses.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.sm: Ia outou iloa, outou e valelea i le nuu; o outou vale foi, tou te popoto afea?

verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.sm: O le na faia le taliga, e le lagona ea e ia? O le na faia le mata, e le silasila atu ea o ia?

verses.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.sm: O lē sasa i nuu ese, e le aoai atu ea e ia? O lē aʻoaʻo i tagata ia popoto, o loo silafia e le ALII o mafaufau o tagata,

verses.en: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.sm: e faatuavaa lava ia. Le Aw: e, amuia le tagata ua e aoaiina;

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.sm: ma e aʻoaʻoina o ia i lau tulafono. Ina ia e tuuina atu se mapu ia te ia i ona po ua puapuaga ai,

verses.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.sm: seia elia le lua mo le ua amio leaga. Auā e le tuuna e le Aw: lona nuu, na “e le tuulafoaiina foi lona tofi.

verses.en: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.sm: Auā e toe foi atu le faamasinoga i le amiotonu;

verses.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.sm: e mulimuli atu foi i ai o i latou uma ua loto faamaoni. O ai se tulai mai mo aʻu e tetee i e ua amio leaga?

verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.sm: o ai se tu atu mo aʻu e tetee i e ua fai mea leaga? Ana le fesoasoani mai ia te au o le ALII, po ua toe itiiti ona nofo lea o loʻu agaga i le mea taaligoligoa.

verses.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.sm: Na ou fai ane, O loo mapeva loʻu vae;

verses.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
verses.sm: ona taofi ae lea o aʻu e lou alofa, le ALII e. O le tele o manatunatu i loʻu

verses.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.sm: loto ua fiafia ai loʻu agaga ona o faamafanafanaga mai ia te oe.

verses.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.sm: 21 22 Io SALAMO 94, E faatasi ea ma oe le nofoalii o i ai amio leaga, o le ua fai ma tulafono le faatiga?

verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.sm: Ua latou feosofi mai i le adada o 1e amiotonu; ua latou faasalaina le tagata e leal sana agasala.

verses.en: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
verses.sm: A e faia le ALII moʻu ‘olo maualuga; o loʻu Atua foi o le papa lea ou te malu ai.

verses.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
verses.sm: E taui atu foi e ia ia te i latou a latou agasala, na te faaumatia foi i latou i a latou amio leaga; o le ALII lo matou Atua na te faaumatia i latou.
